record.paper_title: Graph Partitions: Recent Progresses and Some Open Problems
record.original_question: For positive integers s and t, let f(s,t) be the least connectivity threshold such that every f(s,t)-connected graph can be partitioned into two sets S and T for which the induced subgraphs G[S] and G[T] have connectivity at least s and t, respectively. Is f(s,t) always equal to s + t + 1?

evidence.quote: In 1982, Gy˝ori[32, 63] proposed a problem as follows: for given positive integers s and t, is there an integer f(s, t) such that the vertex set of every f(s, t)-connected graph can be partitioned into two sets S and T which induce subgraphs of connectivity at least s and t respectively?

Then Thomassen made the following
Conjecture 4.1[63] g(s, t) = s + t + 1, and f(s, t) = s + t + 1.
The latter part of Conjecture 4.1 is still open. The best bound f(s, t) ≤ 4s + 4t − 13 is due to Hajnal [32].

artifact.self_contained_problem: For positive integers $s$ and $t$, define $f(s,t)$ to be the least positive integer $k$ (if it exists) such that for every $k$-vertex-connected finite simple graph $G$, the vertex set $V(G)$ admits a partition into two nonempty parts $S$ and $T$ for which the induced subgraph $G[S]$ is $s$-vertex-connected and the induced subgraph $G[T]$ is $t$-vertex-connected. It is known that $f(s,t)$ exists for all positive integers $s,t$, and that $f(s,t) \ge s+t+1$ (as witnessed by the complete graph $K_{s+t+1}$). Determine whether $f(s,t) = s+t+1$ holds for all positive integers $s$ and $t$.
artifact.status_search_result: The equality f(s,t) = s+t+1 is a conjecture of Thomassen. It is known to hold when min{s,t} ≤ 2 (Thomassen). The best general upper bound is Hajnal's f(s,t) ≤ 4s+4t−13 for s,t ≥ 3. The full conjecture appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Thomassen's Vertex Partition Problem
status_evidence.snippet: Thomassen conjectured f(s,t)=s+t+1; verified for min{s,t}≤2; Hajnal showed f(s,t)≤4s+4t−13.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is verified only in special cases; the general statement is open.

status_evidence.title: Partition of graphs with condition on the connectivity and minimum degree (Hajnal, Combinatorica)
status_evidence.claim: Best known upper bound is linear in s+t but not equal to s+t+1.
